$comment: Closed asset-role vocabulary. Every media / link / endpoint / font reference in a PageSpec is an assetRef {assetRole, source, ref?} whose assetRole must be a key here, whose source must be allowed by the role's generationPolicy, and whose ref must not contain any denylisted real-asset string. The source site is a real, live site by a real named author: its logo, 3D model, textures, meta images, author identity links and live endpoints must never be reused or imitated in generated output. Roles marked pinned:true are additionally checked against a hard-coded expected policy in schema/semantic_validate.py (PINNED_POLICIES), so a mutation to a different-but-valid policy is caught. Since 1.1.0 every role also carries an `availability` (see availabilityValues and modes) so a PageSpec in mode 'generated' can be checked against it; availability is pinned per role in extraction/verify_all.py (PINNED_AVAILABILITY) and schema/semantic_validate.py (PINNED_AVAILABILITY).

may-generate-new.meaning: A generator may create a new, original asset for this role.

must-not-reproduce.meaning: Real brand / real person / proprietary asset. Never reuse the original file or URL and never fabricate a look-alike. Use a clearly labelled neutral placeholder; the deployer supplies their own asset.

must-not-reuse-live-endpoint.meaning: A live third-party endpoint or tracking id. Never emit the real URL or id; emit a placeholder the deployer wires to their own backend.

license-required.meaning: Commercial or unverified-licence typeface. Do not ship or embed the font files; reference the fallback stack, or a font the deployer has licensed.

sources.placeholder: Neutral stand-in; ref, if given, must start with 'placeholder:'.
sources.generated: New original asset produced for the page; ref, if given, must start with 'generated:'.
sources.fallback-stack: Use the token fallback stack (Arial, sans-serif); no ref.
sources.licensed-by-deployer: A font the deployer licenses themselves; ref must start with 'licensed:'.

availabilityMeaning.reference-only: The source's own asset or identity. Available only in mode 'reference'. Must name at least one generation-safe substitute role that a generated page uses in its place.
availabilityMeaning.generation-safe: Available in both modes. In mode 'generated' the generationPolicy still limits the source (placeholder / generated / fallback-stack / licensed-by-deployer) and the ref denylists still apply.
availabilityMeaning.blocked: Available only in mode 'reference'; a generated page must omit it. No substitute exists, and the PageSpec field that carries it must be optional so omitting it validates.

modes.reference: A page for the SOURCE brand (clone / fidelity validation). Every role is available, including the reference-only and blocked ones. contentProvenance must be 'evidence-reference' and the route a real route of the template.
modes.generated: A new page for ANY OTHER brand. Only generation-safe roles are available (the reference-only ones have placeholder substitutes, the blocked one is omitted). No text, route, ref or label may carry the source brand, its author, its real hosts or its copy; every URL-like string must sit on a reserved .example or .invalid domain. contentProvenance must be 'generated'.

sourceBrand.$comment: Patterns derived from the real source (extraction/verify_all.py checks each name/host/phrase below against the reference example, the refDenylist and manifest.source.url). Applied to every string of a PageSpec in mode 'generated' by schema/semantic_validate.py.

copyOverlap.meaning: A generated string is rejected if it shares a run of 4 normalised words with the reference example's copy, or equals a whole reference string of 2+ words (normalised: lower-case, letters and digits only).

sourceBrand.urlRule: Every URL-like string (http(s)://..., www..., or a host ending in one of urlLikeTlds) in a generated page must have a host ending in a reservedPlaceholderDomains suffix; anything else is rejected, and the source's real hosts are rejected by name.

brand.logo-mark.description: The 'THE CODE FLOW. CO' logo SVG (nav right cluster, footer legal block).
brand.logo-mark.generatedModeGuidance: The 'THE CODE FLOW. CO' mark. A generated page is a different brand and must not carry it or a look-alike: use brand.logo-placeholder.

icon.arrow.description: Small arrow glyph inside every pill CTA (14x14 viewBox, currentColor).
icon.arrow.generatedModeGuidance: A generic arrow glyph: a generated page may draw its own.

icon.discord.description: Discord glyph in the always-hidden community link. Third-party trademark.
icon.discord.generatedModeGuidance: A third-party trademark in an always-hidden link (mv.structure.discord-hidden). Omit communityLink in a generated page; it has no substitute.

webgl.cube-model.description: The Rubik's-cube GLB (3 layer meshes) rendered by the fixed WebGL layer.
webgl.cube-model.generatedModeGuidance: The source's Rubik's-cube model. Use webgl.model-placeholder (a neutral stand-in or a new original model).

webgl.matcap.description: The two matcap textures (body plastic / stickers) of the cube shader.
webgl.matcap.generatedModeGuidance: The source's matcap textures. Use webgl.matcap-placeholder.

webgl.sticker-colormap.description: The sticker colour map revealed on CTA hover (+10%) and on solve.
webgl.sticker-colormap.generatedModeGuidance: The source's sticker colour map. Use webgl.colormap-placeholder.

meta.og-image.generatedModeGuidance: The source's share image. Use meta.og-placeholder.

identity.author-link.description: Links that identify the real author: personal site, Twitter redirect, privacy-policy Google Doc.
identity.author-link.generatedModeGuidance: Links that identify the real author (personal site, social redirect, privacy-policy document). A generated page links to its own pages: use identity.link-placeholder with a placeholder: ref.

endpoint.form-action.description: Waitlist form submit target. The original posts to a live MailChimp list.
endpoint.form-action.generatedModeGuidance: Never the live MailChimp list: a placeholder: ref the deployer wires to their own backend (placeholder source only).

endpoint.analytics.description: Page analytics script / website id. The original loads Umami with a real website id.
endpoint.analytics.generatedModeGuidance: Never the live Umami id: a placeholder: ref (placeholder source only), or omit the analytics field.

font.commercial-sans.description: Helvetica Neue (400/700) and Helvetica Neue Condensed (700). Commercial typefaces.
font.commercial-sans.generatedModeGuidance: Use the fallback stack, or a font the deployer licenses (licensed-by-deployer); never ship the commercial files.

font.mono.description: Firacode (400/700). No licence file present in the source project.
font.mono.generatedModeGuidance: Use the fallback stack, or a font the deployer licenses (licensed-by-deployer).

brand.logo-placeholder.description: Neutral stand-in for a brand mark (nav right cluster, footer legal block) on a page for another brand.
brand.logo-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Use a placeholder: or generated: ref; the deployer supplies the real mark.

identity.link-placeholder.description: Neutral stand-in for the footer's social, privacy-policy and credit links on a page for another brand.
identity.link-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Placeholder source only, with a placeholder: ref; the deployer wires their own URLs (on a reserved .example or .invalid domain in any visible label).

meta.og-placeholder.description: Neutral stand-in for the Open Graph / Twitter card image.
meta.og-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Use a placeholder: or generated: ref.

meta.favicon-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Use a placeholder: or generated: ref.

webgl.model-placeholder.description: Neutral stand-in for the 3D model rendered by the fixed WebGL layer.
webgl.model-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Use a placeholder: or generated: ref; never the source's model file.

webgl.matcap-placeholder.description: Neutral stand-in for a matcap texture of the WebGL shader.
webgl.matcap-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Use a placeholder: or generated: ref.

webgl.colormap-placeholder.description: Neutral stand-in for the WebGL colour map revealed on CTA hover and on solve.
webgl.colormap-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Use a placeholder: or generated: ref.

refDenylist.$comment: Case-insensitive substrings that must never appear in any assetRef.ref (any provenance). Real file names, hosts and ids from the original.

brandTextDenylist.$comment: Applied to ALL text of a PageSpec whose contentProvenance is 'generated' (case-insensitive; spaces and punctuation collapsed before matching). Real copy may appear only in an 'evidence-reference' PageSpec (the bundled example), which must never be published as the real brand.
